correctness.rationale: Independent pair edge conditioning gives (S_v,S_w)=(B_v+Z,B_w+1-Z), yielding cross covariance -delta_f delta_g/4. Binomial size bias gives Cov(f(R),R)=(n-1)delta_f/4, proving the all-function covariance residual identity for n>=2. Choosing indicators yields exact complete histogram covariance, normalization gives n(I-uu^T-ww^T), with two orthogonal constraints and rank n-2. Krawtchouk generating functions give a complete orthonormal variance basis. Reproduced 871 exact-rational checks, including all 33,866 tournaments at n=2..6; finite checks are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: The score histogram is a natural probability statistic in a full round-robin tournament. All bin counts are dependent despite binomial vertex marginals. The exact covariance projector gives a complete, parameter-free (after normalization), rank-n-2 spectral classification and simultaneously sharp residual variance bounds for all score-additive statistics. Exact Pearson expectation, two constraint modes and Krawtchouk orthogonal contrasts are concrete consequences useful in uncertainty quantification; this is neither a mere marginal computation nor an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
